promptHead: Athlete goal: 5K (Corrowmore Harvest 5K) on Sun Nov 15 2026, 10 weeks out, target run the whole way.

new.headline: Focus on steady volume growth and keep quality work to one session; no need to run every day next week.

flags.title: Intensity
flags.detail: keep HR <150 bpm during easy runs, 5k pace only Saturday.

flags.title: Calf soreness
flags.detail: monitor tightness after runs, rest if pain persists.

flags.title: Recovery
flags.detail: ensure at least 24 h after quality before next run.

answers.question: I want to be ready for the 5K in November. Should I run every day next week to get there faster?
answers.answer: No, keep the 3 runs; you’re on track. Add the quality session on Saturday, and let rest days do the rest.

new.analysis:
The week adds modest volume, keeping total mileage 7–8 km, a 5–10% increase from last week’s 6.78 km.
Intensity stays low; only one quality session on Saturday at near 5‑k pace.
A new runner needs time to adapt; daily runs would risk overuse injury, so rest days preserve recovery.

days.notes: keep pace under 150 bpm, flat route. Keeps legs fresh.
